messages:
Ajay: fyi, CI SAST/DAST started erroring on most PRs after the role change applied last night :thinking_face:
Sarah: which role change? the one rolled by infra at ~02:10 UTC? :eyes:
Ajay: yeah, that one. the scan-runner job is failing when trying to pull secrets from KMS. logs show AccessDenied on decrypt.
Kevin: confirmed. sample log from scan-agent:
```
2026-02-14T02:15:03Z scan-agent ERROR KMS Decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: user arn:aws:sts::11111:assumed-role/scan-runner-role/session is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:11111:key/abc-123
```
Sarah: Ugh. The infra change removed the old inline policy and attached the new scoped policy for "scan:read" but forgot to include kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey.
Maria: do we have an audit trail for who merged that? we need to page infra and product security.
Ajay: I pulled CloudTrail entries, looks like the role update was done by infra-bot via a PR merge (PR 1287) authored by @kevin.
Kevin: that was me — I updated role scoping to reduce blast radius, didn't realize the scanner needed decrypt perms. my bad. :grimacing:
Sarah: ok quick mitigation: add a narrow policy allowing kms:Decrypt only for the scanner key and limit to sts:AssumedRole principal for scan-runner-role. Example policy snippet: 
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:11111:key/abc-123",
      "Condition": {
        "StringEquals": {"aws:PrincipalTag/role": "scan-runner"}
      }
    }
  ]
}
```
Kevin: i'll push that as an emergency hotfix to infra PR and deploy.
deploy-bot: triggered deploy pipeline #scan-hotfix-2026-02-14, job 7845 started
Ajay: also we should restore CI green by adding a temporary lifecycle rule to skip KMS-backed checks for flaky external PRs while we patch infra. maybe add a short-circuit in the scan runner: `if env.SKIP_KMS` toggle.
Sarah: agree. patching the runner is safer than allowing broad kms perms. please include audit logging so we can see future role edits.
Maria: action items?
Sarah: 1) Kevin to open infra PR with tight kms policy (ETA 30m). 2) Ajay to add SKIP_KMS env toggle and short-lived bypass for PR queue (ETA 1h). 3) Kevin to add CloudTrail alert for IAM role modifications on scan-runner-role (ETA today). 4) Security to file postmortem and update RBAC checklist.
Kevin: creating ticket SR-4932 and adding myself + Ajay + Sarah.
sec-bot: incident SR-4932 created <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SR-4932> and assigned to Kevin, Ajay, Sarah
Maria: please include the scan failures evidence in the ticket (logs, failing PRs list, timestamps).
Ajay: added quick grep for failing PRs:
```
aws logs filter-log-events --log-group /redwood/scan-agent --filter-pattern "AccessDeniedException" --start-time 1707800000000
```
Sarah: once hotfix is deployed, I'll run a smoke on the main branch and confirm DAST & SAST results. tagging @oncall in case of followups. :thumbsup:
Kevin: hotfix merged and infra policy attached. monitoring CI now.
deploy-bot: scan-hotfix-2026-02-14 pipeline succeeded in 8m
Ajay: CI looks green on latest runs, re-running a few queued PRs to be sure.
Sarah: will prepare a short postmortem and update the RBAC change checklist: require KMS perms review + CI smoke before rollout.
Maria: thanks all — please CC security leads when you post the postmortem.
Kevin: sorry again, learned a lot. will be more cautious with scoped-role rollouts. :bow:
